The Story

Not just a marketer.
A growth architect.


Most businesses struggle not because of bad products — but because of weak positioning and inconsistent marketing. The market doesn't reward the best product. It rewards the best-communicated one.

My approach combines branding, creative strategy, content, and performance marketing to build sustainable growth systems. Not one-time campaigns. Not vanity metrics. Real business outcomes.

With over 3 years of experience working with local businesses and e-commerce brands across Bangladesh, I focus on the full stack: from how your brand is positioned in the market to how every ad dollar is optimized.

Meta Ads Brand Strategy SEO Google Analytics Growth Marketing Bangladesh
What I Do

Marketing that
actually moves business.

Every service connects to a single objective: measurable, compounding growth for your brand. Strategy first. Execution always.

Meta Ads Strategy

Campaign architecture, audience targeting, creative testing, and ROAS optimization for Facebook & Instagram — designed to scale.

Brand Positioning

Market differentiation, messaging architecture, and brand narrative that makes your business the obvious choice for the right audience.

Content Strategy

Content planning rooted in audience psychology — built to build trust, demonstrate expertise, and drive intent at every funnel stage.

SEO Optimization

On-page, technical, and content SEO strategy to build sustainable organic visibility — traffic that compounds over time without paid dependency.

Google Analytics

Data setup, tracking architecture, and insight extraction — so your marketing decisions are grounded in evidence, not assumptions.

Performance Marketing

Full-funnel performance management — channel mix, bid strategy, attribution, and continuous optimization toward business-level KPIs.
